## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Design and impact

Explain important design choices, compatibility impact, and operator-visible
changes.

## Verification

List the tests, static checks, and realistic runtime validation performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are synchronized.
- [ ] No secrets, local configuration, databases, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Dependency and lock-file changes are intentional and explained.
